eCOTS 2026 Sparking Joy and Discovery in a World of AI
On Friday, June 12th, 2026, Megan Mocko and Beth Johnson hosted the North Florida Regional Conference in connection with eCOTS. Andrea Ramirez-Salgado, PhD was the invited keynote speaker who discussed the connections between statistics and AI. Professor Kshitij Khare named 2026 UFRF Professor
The University of Florida Research Foundation (UFRF) has recognized 33 faculty members as UFRF Professors for 2026, honoring them for work that advances discovery, creativity and innovation across the university.
